conditions.condition_text: Identify a P-shape (bullish) or B-shape (bearish) profile, which indicates an area of imbalance (Low Volume Node).
These shapes show where the market consolidated or moved quickly through an area of low volume.
Determine if the profile was formed by smart money exiting (defensive move/trap) or entering (offensive move/continuation).
Defensive moves (covering/exiting) are likely to fail, creating a trap.
Wait for the market to fake out in the direction of the initial bias (the trap).
The fakeout is the signal that the opposing side is trapped.
Enter on the reversal/break of the Point of Control (POC) or a key level (VAH/VAL) after the fakeout.
The POC failure indicates the initial directional bias is failing.
The market moved quickly through areas of low volume, indicating imbalance.
The profile must match a P or B shape, indicating a potential trap.
The trade must be taken based on whether smart money is exiting (defensive) or entering (offensive).
The stop is placed below the Point of Control to invalidate the trap.
The target is the end of the area of imbalance (the vacuum).
